/obj/item/access_key.name: access key ring
/obj/item/access_key.reason: Janitor's key ring that opens doors only when a department access has been granted to it.

/obj/item/analyzer.name: gas analyzer
/obj/item/analyzer.reason: Reads gas. Also reads an anomaly's code, which is how you claim its core.

/obj/item/analyzer/honest_gauge.name: the honest gauge
/obj/item/analyzer/honest_gauge.reason: Authored unique, so it stays off shelves. Reads gas, machine parts and hidden wiring. Handy readouts, no power.

/obj/item/anomaly_neutralizer.name: anomaly neutralizer
/obj/item/anomaly_neutralizer.reason: One use, ends an anomaly on contact and drops its core. A signaler and analyzer do the same for free once you read the code. This is the quick way.

/obj/item/anomaly_releaser.name: anomaly releaser
/obj/item/anomaly_releaser.reason: Turns a finished core back into a live anomaly that never fades, wherever you stand. A nasty trap to leave on someone's ship. Ruins only.

/obj/item/assembly/control.name: blast door controller
/obj/item/assembly/control.reason: Wall button circuit for blast doors.

/obj/item/assembly/control/crematorium.name: crematorium controller
/obj/item/assembly/control/crematorium.reason: Wall button circuit for a crematorium.

/obj/item/assembly/control/flasher.name: flasher controller
/obj/item/assembly/control/flasher.reason: Wall button circuit for wall flashers.

/obj/item/assembly/control/massdriver.name: mass driver controller
/obj/item/assembly/control/massdriver.reason: Wall button circuit for mass drivers.

/obj/item/assembly/control/transport/cal.name: tram call button
/obj/item/assembly/control/transport/cal.reason: Calls the tram in the one ruin that has one.

/obj/item/assembly/flash.name: flash
/obj/item/assembly/flash.reason: Point blank, it drops anyone facing you with no eye protection: 80 to 120 stamina and a knockdown. It can burn out if spammed. Any flash-proof eyewear stops it. Found on robotics modules.

/obj/item/assembly/flash/cyborg.name: flash
/obj/item/assembly/flash/cyborg.reason: Point blank, it drops anyone facing you with no eye protection: 80 to 120 stamina and a knockdown. It can burn out if spammed. Any flash-proof eyewear stops it. A cyborg version found in ruins.

/obj/item/assembly/flash/handheld.name: flash
/obj/item/assembly/flash/handheld.reason: Point blank, it drops anyone facing you with no eye protection: 80 to 120 stamina and a knockdown. It can burn out if spammed. Any flash-proof eyewear stops it. Common on job outfits and prints for 3 cr of material at a mech fabricator.

/obj/item/assembly/flash/memorizer.name: memorizer
/obj/item/assembly/flash/memorizer.reason: A flash with a different look. Point blank, it drops anyone facing you with no eye protection: 80 to 120 stamina and a knockdown. It can burn out if spammed. Any flash-proof eyewear stops it. Rare maintenance spawn.

/obj/item/assembly/health.name: health sensor
/obj/item/assembly/health.reason: A part for gadgets and traps. Whatever it ends up in gets rated, not the part.

/obj/item/assembly/igniter.name: igniter
/obj/item/assembly/igniter.reason: A part for gadgets and traps. Whatever it ends up in gets rated, not the part.

/obj/item/assembly/igniter/condenser.name: condenser
/obj/item/assembly/igniter/condenser.reason: A part for gadgets and traps. Whatever it ends up in gets rated, not the part.

/obj/item/assembly/infra.name: infrared emitter
/obj/item/assembly/infra.reason: A part for gadgets and traps. Whatever it ends up in gets rated, not the part.

/obj/item/assembly/mousetrap.name: mousetrap
/obj/item/assembly/mousetrap.reason: Snaps on whoever steps on it, for little damage.

/obj/item/assembly/prox_sensor.name: proximity sensor
/obj/item/assembly/prox_sensor.reason: A part for gadgets and traps. Whatever it ends up in gets rated, not the part.

/obj/item/assembly/shock_kit.name: electrohelmet assembly
/obj/item/assembly/shock_kit.reason: Half-built electric chair part. One ruin.

/obj/item/assembly/signaler.name: remote signaling device
/obj/item/assembly/signaler.reason: Remote signal part. Also how you pop an anomaly for its core. 1 cr of material.

/obj/item/assembly/signaler/anomaly/bios.name: bioscrambler anomaly core
/obj/item/assembly/signaler/anomaly/bios.reason: Uncommon core. Makes limb-swapping reactive armor or powers a polymorph belt.

/obj/item/assembly/signaler/anomaly/blue.name: bluespace anomaly core
/obj/item/assembly/signaler/anomaly/blue.reason: Rare core. Makes a bag of holding or teleporting reactive armor and is needed for a Phazon. Each of those is a big step up on its own.

/obj/item/assembly/signaler/anomaly/dime.name: dimensional anomaly core
/obj/item/assembly/signaler/anomaly/dime.reason: Uncommon core. Makes barricade reactive armor or a terrain-warping bomb core.

/obj/item/assembly/signaler/anomaly/ecto.name: ectoplasm anomaly core
/obj/item/assembly/signaler/anomaly/ecto.reason: Uncommon core. Makes ectoplasm reactive armor. Otherwise research points or 400 cr.

/obj/item/assembly/signaler/anomaly/flux.name: flux anomaly core
/obj/item/assembly/signaler/anomaly/flux.reason: Common core. With a kit it makes a tesla cannon, and alone it makes tesla reactive armor. Costs only a signaler and an analyzer, so the kit is the real gate.

/obj/item/assembly/signaler/anomaly/grav.name: gravitational anomaly core
/obj/item/assembly/signaler/anomaly/grav.reason: Common core. Makes repulse reactive armor or a MOD gravity module. One part of an Event Horizon.

/obj/item/assembly/signaler/anomaly/hall.name: hallucination anomaly core
/obj/item/assembly/signaler/anomaly/hall.reason: Common core. Makes hallucinating reactive armor or powers a psychic helmet.

/obj/item/assembly/signaler/anomaly/pyro.name: pyroclastic anomaly core
/obj/item/assembly/signaler/anomaly/pyro.reason: Common core. Makes stealth reactive armor. Otherwise research points or 400 cr.

/obj/item/assembly/signaler/anomaly/vort.name: vortex anomaly core
/obj/item/assembly/signaler/anomaly/vort.reason: Rare core. Two go into a supermatter sword or an Event Horizon, though one alone makes only stealth reactive armor.

/obj/item/assembly/signaler/cyborg.name: remote signaling device
/obj/item/assembly/signaler/cyborg.reason: A part for gadgets and traps. Whatever it ends up in gets rated, not the part.

/obj/item/assembly/timer.name: timer
/obj/item/assembly/timer.reason: A part for gadgets and traps. Whatever it ends up in gets rated, not the part.

/obj/item/assembly/voice.name: voice analyzer
/obj/item/assembly/voice.reason: A part for gadgets and traps. Whatever it ends up in gets rated, not the part.

/obj/item/beacon.name: tracking beacon
/obj/item/beacon.reason: Marks a spot for a teleporter to aim at.

/obj/item/binoculars.name: binoculars
/obj/item/binoculars.note: Wielding it with both hands zooms the view out toward the cursor (4 times the normal view range), and lowering it, swapping hands or moving it out of the hands ends the zoom. While wielded the user is slowed (+1.5).
/obj/item/binoculars.reason: Zooms your view out to 4 times normal while wielded, and slows you. Good for spotting from a ridge.

/obj/item/bodybag/bluespace.name: bluespace body bag
/obj/item/bodybag/bluespace.reason: Folds up with bodies inside, so one person can carry the fallen home in a pocket. 123 cr of material.

/obj/item/bodybag/environmental.name: environmental protection bag
/obj/item/bodybag/environmental.reason: Body bag that seals out fire and vacuum.

/obj/item/boxcutter.name: boxcutter
/obj/item/boxcutter.reason: Folding blade at 10 force. Weak, cheap and easily replaced by a real knife.

/obj/item/camera.name: camera
/obj/item/camera.note: Clicking something in view takes a photo of a square of tiles around it (3 wide by default, up to 7) with a flash; 10 shots per film roll, 6.4 seconds between shots, and film can only be loaded once the camera is empty. Hitting a mob with it does nothing. The camera obscura variant also shows ghosts in photos and deals 10-15 damage to spirit-type mobs it photographs, revealing and paralyzing a revenant for 2 seconds.

/obj/item/camera/spooky.name: camera obscura
/obj/item/camera/spooky.note: Clicking something in view takes a photo of a square of tiles around it (3 wide by default, up to 7) with a flash; 10 shots per film roll, 6.4 seconds between shots, and film can only be loaded once the camera is empty. Hitting a mob with it does nothing. The camera obscura variant also shows ghosts in photos and deals 10-15 damage to spirit-type mobs it photographs, revealing and paralyzing a revenant for 2 seconds.
/obj/item/camera/spooky.reason: Camera that shows ghosts in photos and stings spirit mobs. Niche.

/obj/item/chisel.name: chisel
/obj/item/chisel.note: On a carving block it sculpts a statue of a chosen target or preset over 30 seconds, cancelled if the user moves or drops it; right-click on a wall engraves one of the user's memories (5 seconds). With combat mode on it does 200 extra damage to statue mobs, and aimed at the eyes it stabs for 7 brute and damages the eyes, which with repeat hits causes blur, dropped items and paralysis. It also scrapes rust, taking triple the normal time.
/obj/item/chisel.reason: For carving statues and scraping rust. Its eye stab does 7.

/obj/item/climbing_hook.name: climbing hook
/obj/item/climbing_hook.reason: Climbs up one level. Most places have one level.

/obj/item/climbing_hook/syndicate.name: suspicious climbing hook
/obj/item/climbing_hook/syndicate.reason: Climbs up one level in under a second. Most places have one level.

/obj/item/construction/plumbing.name: Plumbing Constructor
/obj/item/construction/plumbing.reason: Builds chem factories out of piping. A chemist's force multiplier, with no direct fight power.

/obj/item/construction/plumbing/service.name: service plumbing constructor
/obj/item/construction/plumbing/service.reason: Plumbing constructor for kitchens and bars.

/obj/item/construction/rcd.name: rapid-construction-device (RCD)
/obj/item/construction/rcd.reason: The same RCD with an empty tank. It reloads on iron, glass or cartridges.

/obj/item/construction/rcd/ce.name: professional RCD
/obj/item/construction/rcd/ce.reason: RCD with the cooling and anti-interrupt upgrades built in. No shop, ruin or played hull has it.

/obj/item/construction/rcd/combat.name: industrial RCD
/obj/item/construction/rcd/combat.reason: Industrial RCD: 500 matter, every upgrade and it cuts reinforced walls. That makes it a real breaching tool. One ruin has it.

/obj/item/construction/rcd/exosuit.name: mounted RCD
/obj/item/construction/rcd/exosuit.reason: Mech-mounted RCD. Works from 3 tiles in half the time and cuts reinforced walls, but it needs a mech.

/obj/item/construction/rcd/loaded.name: rapid-construction-device (RCD)
/obj/item/construction/rcd/loaded.reason: Best work tool in the game: repairs hull and builds rooms fast, and takes plain walls down in 4 s and doors in 5 s. It stops at reinforced walls. In the backpack of 16 engineer outfits.

/obj/item/construction/rld/mini.name: mini-rapid-light-device
/obj/item/construction/rld/mini.reason: Places lights fast, with a smaller tank.

/obj/item/crowbar/abductor.name: alien crowbar
/obj/item/crowbar/abductor.reason: Alien tool that works in a tenth of the normal time. A full set takes a reinforced wall apart in seconds, which helps boarding and repair but wins no fight by itself. Sold for 900 cr, and it's also the sample that opens alien research.

/obj/item/crowbar/cyborg.name: hydraulic crowbar
/obj/item/crowbar/cyborg.reason: Tool at half the normal time. Slightly faster work and nothing else.

/obj/item/crowbar/hammer.name: claw hammer
/obj/item/crowbar/hammer.reason: Claw hammer. Bad at prying, but 11 force with a large wound bonus breaks bones. A cheap ruin club.

/obj/item/crowbar/large.name: large crowbar
/obj/item/crowbar/large.reason: Large crowbar. 12 force, about a baseball bat, and slightly faster than a pocket crowbar.

/obj/item/crowbar/large/emergency.name: emergency crowbar
/obj/item/crowbar/large/emergency.reason: Large crowbar too bulky for a bag. 12 force. Found in emergency lockers.

/obj/item/crowbar/large/old.name: old crowbar
/obj/item/crowbar/large/old.reason: Large crowbar. 12 force, about a baseball bat, and slightly faster than a pocket crowbar.

/obj/item/crowbar/large/twenty_force.name: heavy crowbar
/obj/item/crowbar/large/twenty_force.reason: Heavy crowbar. 20 force in one hand, the same as the green combat knife, and still a crowbar. Only from ruin weapon rolls.

/obj/item/crowbar/power.name: jaws of life
/obj/item/crowbar/power.reason: Jaws of life. Pries any powered door that isn't bolted, snaps cuffs at once and hits for 15. It takes a boarding party through doors without hacking, for 93 cr of material and no reputation.

/obj/item/crowbar/red/caravan.name: experimental crowbar
/obj/item/crowbar/red/caravan.reason: Experimental tool at about a third of the normal time. Faster work and nothing else.

/obj/item/door_remote/captain.name: command door remote
/obj/item/door_remote/captain.reason: Opens or bolts any powered door it has access to, from across a room. A crew convenience that also traps people. In the captain's locker on 9 hulls.

/obj/item/door_remote/chief_medical_offi.name: medical door remote
/obj/item/door_remote/chief_medical_offi.reason: Opens or bolts any powered door it has access to, from across a room. A crew convenience that also traps people.

/obj/item/door_remote/head_of_personnel.name: service door remote
/obj/item/door_remote/head_of_personnel.reason: Opens or bolts any powered door it has access to, from across a room. A crew convenience that also traps people.

/obj/item/door_remote/quartermaster.name: cargo door remote
/obj/item/door_remote/quartermaster.reason: Opens or bolts any powered door it has access to, from across a room. A crew convenience that also traps people.

/obj/item/door_remote/research_director.name: research door remote
/obj/item/door_remote/research_director.reason: Opens or bolts any powered door it has access to, from across a room. A crew convenience that also traps people.

/obj/item/door_seal.name: pneumatic airlock seal
/obj/item/door_seal.reason: Braces an airlock shut in 3 s, and takes 2 s to undo. It slows people down without stopping them.

/obj/item/emergency_bed.name: roller bed
/obj/item/emergency_bed.reason: Wheels a patient along. Faster than dragging.

/obj/item/experi_scanner.name: Experi-Scanner
/obj/item/experi_scanner.reason: Scans things for research experiments. Worth research points, not power.

/obj/item/extendohand.name: extendo-hand
/obj/item/extendohand.note: Reach 2: used on a living target exactly two tiles away it performs the wielder's bare-hand interaction on them (hug, punch and so on, per intent) instead of a weapon hit. Used on a closer target it only says they are too close, and the item itself has no melee force.
/obj/item/extendohand.reason: Boxing glove on a stick. It hugs or punches from 2 tiles and has no force of its own.

/obj/item/extinguisher.name: fire extinguisher
/obj/item/extinguisher.note: Safety starts on; with it off, clicking sprays 5 particles (5 units) in a 3-tile-wide fan out to 5 tiles, once per 1.2 seconds, putting out fires on mobs, objects and hotspots; the user is pushed back in zero-g and a buckled unanchored chair is driven away. The standard bulky one also has a right-click head bash on carbons (2 second windup, 39 brute with a strong blunt wound bonus); advanced uses foam, a 5-wide fan with no repeated tiles and holds 100 units, and the crafted spray holds 30 and reaches 3 tiles.
/obj/item/extinguisher.reason: Puts out fires. Also has a right-click head bash: 2 s wind-up, 39 brute and a severe wound. That's brutal on anyone stunned or cuffed, and it's in every cabinet.

/obj/item/extinguisher/advanced.name: advanced fire extinguisher
/obj/item/extinguisher/advanced.note: Safety starts on; with it off, clicking sprays 5 particles (5 units) in a 3-tile-wide fan out to 5 tiles, once per 1.2 seconds, putting out fires on mobs, objects and hotspots; the user is pushed back in zero-g and a buckled unanchored chair is driven away. The standard bulky one also has a right-click head bash on carbons (2 second windup, 39 brute with a strong blunt wound bonus); advanced uses foam, a 5-wide fan with no repeated tiles and holds 100 units, and the crafted spray holds 30 and reaches 3 tiles.
/obj/item/extinguisher/advanced.reason: Foam, a wider spray and twice the capacity. No head bash. The fire tool of choice.

/obj/item/extinguisher/advanced/empty.name: advanced fire extinguisher
/obj/item/extinguisher/advanced/empty.note: Safety starts on; with it off, clicking sprays 5 particles (5 units) in a 3-tile-wide fan out to 5 tiles, once per 1.2 seconds, putting out fires on mobs, objects and hotspots; the user is pushed back in zero-g and a buckled unanchored chair is driven away. The standard bulky one also has a right-click head bash on carbons (2 second windup, 39 brute with a strong blunt wound bonus); advanced uses foam, a 5-wide fan with no repeated tiles and holds 100 units, and the crafted spray holds 30 and reaches 3 tiles.

/obj/item/extinguisher/crafted.name: Improvised cooling spray
/obj/item/extinguisher/crafted.note: Safety starts on; with it off, clicking sprays 5 particles (5 units) in a 3-tile-wide fan out to 5 tiles, once per 1.2 seconds, putting out fires on mobs, objects and hotspots; the user is pushed back in zero-g and a buckled unanchored chair is driven away. The standard bulky one also has a right-click head bash on carbons (2 second windup, 39 brute with a strong blunt wound bonus); advanced uses foam, a 5-wide fan with no repeated tiles and holds 100 units, and the crafted spray holds 30 and reaches 3 tiles.
/obj/item/extinguisher/crafted.reason: Crafted from a spray can. 30 units and short reach.

/obj/item/extinguisher/empty.name: fire extinguisher
/obj/item/extinguisher/empty.note: Safety starts on; with it off, clicking sprays 5 particles (5 units) in a 3-tile-wide fan out to 5 tiles, once per 1.2 seconds, putting out fires on mobs, objects and hotspots; the user is pushed back in zero-g and a buckled unanchored chair is driven away. The standard bulky one also has a right-click head bash on carbons (2 second windup, 39 brute with a strong blunt wound bonus); advanced uses foam, a 5-wide fan with no repeated tiles and holds 100 units, and the crafted spray holds 30 and reaches 3 tiles.
/obj/item/extinguisher/empty.reason: The same extinguisher and head bash, printed empty. 1 cr of material.

/obj/item/extinguisher/mini.name: pocket fire extinguisher
/obj/item/extinguisher/mini.note: Safety starts on; with it off, clicking sprays 5 particles (5 units) in a 3-tile-wide fan out to 5 tiles, once per 1.2 seconds, putting out fires on mobs, objects and hotspots; the user is pushed back in zero-g and a buckled unanchored chair is driven away. The standard bulky one also has a right-click head bash on carbons (2 second windup, 39 brute with a strong blunt wound bonus); advanced uses foam, a 5-wide fan with no repeated tiles and holds 100 units, and the crafted spray holds 30 and reaches 3 tiles.

/obj/item/extinguisher/mini/empty.name: pocket fire extinguisher
/obj/item/extinguisher/mini/empty.note: Safety starts on; with it off, clicking sprays 5 particles (5 units) in a 3-tile-wide fan out to 5 tiles, once per 1.2 seconds, putting out fires on mobs, objects and hotspots; the user is pushed back in zero-g and a buckled unanchored chair is driven away. The standard bulky one also has a right-click head bash on carbons (2 second windup, 39 brute with a strong blunt wound bonus); advanced uses foam, a 5-wide fan with no repeated tiles and holds 100 units, and the crafted spray holds 30 and reaches 3 tiles.

/obj/item/extraction_pack.name: fulton extraction pack
/obj/item/extraction_pack.reason: Balloon sends anything unbolted, people included, to your own beacon. Outdoors only, 5 s to attach, 3 uses. Good for hauling loot and fallen crew home.

/obj/item/field_contract_pad.name: field contract pad
/obj/item/field_contract_pad.reason: Settles contracts wherever you stand and drops the pay at your feet. It saves the trip home on every job. 3,600 cr, 2 vouchers and rep 4.

/obj/item/flashlight.name: flashlight
/obj/item/flashlight.reason: A light. No bearing on power or progress.

/obj/item/flashlight/flare.name: flare
/obj/item/flashlight/flare.reason: A light. No bearing on power or progress.

/obj/item/flashlight/flare/candle.name: red candle
/obj/item/flashlight/flare/candle.reason: A light. No bearing on power or progress.

/obj/item/flashlight/flare/candle/infini.name: eternal candle
/obj/item/flashlight/flare/candle/infini.reason: A light. No bearing on power or progress.

/obj/item/flashlight/flare/candle/widows.name: widow's candle
/obj/item/flashlight/flare/candle/widows.reason: Authored unique, so it stays off shelves. Lets a corpse's ghost say one last thing through the flame. Flavor, with no power.

/obj/item/flashlight/flare/torch.name: torch
/obj/item/flashlight/flare/torch.reason: A light. No bearing on power or progress.

/obj/item/flashlight/flare/torch/everbur.name: everburning torch
/obj/item/flashlight/flare/torch/everbur.reason: Torch that never goes out and hits for 10. A light with a dull edge.

/obj/item/flashlight/flashdark.name: flashdark
/obj/item/flashlight/flashdark.reason: Throws a small bubble of darkness instead of light. A trick, not an edge.

/obj/item/flashlight/glowstick.name: glowstick
/obj/item/flashlight/glowstick.reason: A light. No bearing on power or progress.

/obj/item/flashlight/glowstick/blue.name: blue glowstick
/obj/item/flashlight/glowstick/blue.reason: A light. No bearing on power or progress.

/obj/item/flashlight/glowstick/cyan.name: cyan glowstick
/obj/item/flashlight/glowstick/cyan.reason: A light. No bearing on power or progress.

/obj/item/flashlight/glowstick/orange.name: orange glowstick
/obj/item/flashlight/glowstick/orange.reason: A light. No bearing on power or progress.

/obj/item/flashlight/glowstick/pink.name: pink glowstick
/obj/item/flashlight/glowstick/pink.reason: A light. No bearing on power or progress.

/obj/item/flashlight/glowstick/red.name: red glowstick
/obj/item/flashlight/glowstick/red.reason: A light. No bearing on power or progress.

/obj/item/flashlight/glowstick/yellow.name: yellow glowstick
/obj/item/flashlight/glowstick/yellow.reason: A light. No bearing on power or progress.

/obj/item/flashlight/lamp.name: desk lamp
/obj/item/flashlight/lamp.reason: A light. No bearing on power or progress.

/obj/item/flashlight/lamp/bananalamp.name: banana lamp
/obj/item/flashlight/lamp/bananalamp.reason: A light. No bearing on power or progress.

/obj/item/flashlight/lamp/green.name: desk lamp
/obj/item/flashlight/lamp/green.reason: A light. No bearing on power or progress.

/obj/item/flashlight/lantern.name: lantern
/obj/item/flashlight/lantern.reason: A light. No bearing on power or progress.

/obj/item/flashlight/lantern/censer_quie.name: censer of the quiet parish
/obj/item/flashlight/lantern/censer_quie.reason: Authored unique. Lit on the belt, the local wildlife leaves you alone, short of megafauna. It removes most of what makes a planet dangerous.

/obj/item/flashlight/lantern/jade.name: jade lantern
/obj/item/flashlight/lantern/jade.reason: A light. No bearing on power or progress.

/obj/item/flashlight/lantern/jade/on.name: jade lantern
/obj/item/flashlight/lantern/jade/on.reason: A light. No bearing on power or progress.

/obj/item/flashlight/lantern/on.name: lantern
/obj/item/flashlight/lantern/on.reason: A light. No bearing on power or progress.

/obj/item/flashlight/lantern/syndicate.name: suspicious lantern
/obj/item/flashlight/lantern/syndicate.reason: A light. No bearing on power or progress.

/obj/item/flashlight/pen/paramedic.name: paramedic penlight
/obj/item/flashlight/pen/paramedic.reason: Penlight with a short UV burst, for medics.

/obj/item/flashlight/seclite.name: seclite
/obj/item/flashlight/seclite.reason: Flashlight that hits for 9. A light first and a poor club second.

/obj/item/flashlight/slime.name: glowing slime extract
/obj/item/flashlight/slime.reason: A glowing slime extract used as a light.

/obj/item/forcefield_projector.name: forcefield projector
/obj/item/forcefield_projector.reason: Up to 3 forcefields at 7 tiles that stop people, bullets and air, though lasers pass through. Damage drains a shared 250 charge rather than breaking a field. 4 cr of material after 120 research points.

/obj/item/freight_beacon.name: freight beacon
/obj/item/freight_beacon.reason: Buys off the waystation's core shelf and pods it to you anywhere. Three drops. Rep 4.

/obj/item/fulton_core.name: extraction beacon assembly kit
/obj/item/fulton_core.reason: The beacon that fulton packs fly to. No use without packs.

/obj/item/gps.name: global positioning system
/obj/item/gps.reason: Shows where other GPS units are, so a crew can find each other on a planet. Cheap and common.

/obj/item/gps/computer.name: pod computer
/obj/item/gps/computer.reason: Bolted-down pod computer in a few ruins, working as a GPS.

/obj/item/gps/mining.name: global positioning system
/obj/item/gps/mining.reason: Shows where other GPS units are, so a crew can find each other on a planet. Cheap and common.

/obj/item/gps/science.name: global positioning system
/obj/item/gps/science.reason: Shows where other GPS units are, so a crew can find each other on a planet. Cheap and common. The shop sells it for 400 cr, though a plain one prints for 2.

/obj/item/gps/spaceruin.name: global positioning system
/obj/item/gps/spaceruin.reason: Shows where other GPS units are, so a crew can find each other on a planet. Cheap and common. Left around in ruins.

/obj/item/grapple_gun.name: grapple gun
/obj/item/grapple_gun.reason: Zips you 9 tiles to a target in low pressure only. Handy on rock, dear at 3,000 mining points.

/obj/item/holosign_creator/atmos.name: ATMOS holofan projector
/obj/item/holosign_creator/atmos.reason: Six holofans that stop air loss while people walk through. The right fix for a breach.

/obj/item/holosign_creator/engineering.name: engineering holobarrier projector
/obj/item/holosign_creator/engineering.reason: Twelve one-hit barriers that stop people running into a hazard. Walk and you pass through.

/obj/item/holosign_creator/medical.name: PENLITE barrier projector
/obj/item/holosign_creator/medical.reason: Hard-light barrier projector. Blocks people or air for a little while, and any real hit breaks it. Six at a time, and it stops the sick.

/obj/item/holosign_creator/robot_seat/ba.name: bar seating indicator placer
/obj/item/holosign_creator/robot_seat/ba.reason: Marks bar seats for serving robots.

/obj/item/holosign_creator/robot_seat/re.name: restaurant seating indicator placer
/obj/item/holosign_creator/robot_seat/re.reason: Marks restaurant seats for serving robots.

/obj/item/holosign_creator/security.name: security holobarrier projector
/obj/item/holosign_creator/security.reason: Hard-light barrier projector. Blocks people or air for a little while, and any real hit breaks it. Six at a time.

/obj/item/inducer.name: inducer
/obj/item/inducer.reason: Charges cells from its own battery: APCs, mechs and machines, away from any charger. It refuses energy guns, so it's a repair tool and not an ammo supply.

/obj/item/inducer/empty.name: inducer
/obj/item/inducer/empty.reason: Inducer with no battery. Prints for 4 cr of material after 40 research points.

/obj/item/inducer/orderable.name: inducer
/obj/item/inducer/orderable.reason: Inducer with a quarter of the battery. Comes in a cargo crate.

/obj/item/inducer/sci.name: inducer
/obj/item/inducer/sci.reason: Inducer with no battery, in science colors.

/obj/item/inducer/syndicate.name: inducer
/obj/item/inducer/syndicate.reason: Inducer with twice the battery and twice the speed. Found on two ship modules.

/obj/item/inspector.name: N-spect scanner
/obj/item/inspector.reason: Prints inspection reports for cargo bounties.

/obj/item/kheiral_cuffs.name: Kheiral cuffs
/obj/item/kheiral_cuffs.reason: Worn on the wrists, it keeps your suit sensors reporting from away and turns on a GPS. It takes the glove slot.

/obj/item/laser_pointer.name: laser pointer
/obj/item/laser_pointer.reason: Can dazzle a target's eyes at range. A nuisance, not a stun.

/obj/item/laser_pointer/upgraded.name: laser pointer
/obj/item/laser_pointer/upgraded.reason: Can dazzle a target's eyes with a better diode. A nuisance, not a stun.

/obj/item/lazarus_injector.name: lazarus injector
/obj/item/lazarus_injector.reason: Brings a dead animal back as your pet, bosses excepted. A decent bodyguard for 1,000 mining points.

/obj/item/locator.name: bluespace locator
/obj/item/locator.reason: Tracks tracking implants within 35 tiles. Only useful with implants already placed.

/obj/item/longwalk_rig.name: longwalk rig
/obj/item/longwalk_rig.reason: Authored unique. Permanent speed boost worn on the belt, plus a 4-tile dash over lava and chasms every 8 s. Nothing buyable moves like it.

/obj/item/market_uplink/blackmarket.name: Black Market Uplink
/obj/item/market_uplink/blackmarket.reason: Crafted from five cheap parts with no reputation. It opens a rotating shop you can use anywhere, selling EMP grenades, rocket boots, collar bombs and more.

/obj/item/mining_scanner.name: manual mining scanner
/obj/item/mining_scanner.reason: Manual ore scanner. Click for a look at nearby ore. Common on hulls.

/obj/item/multitool.name: multitool
/obj/item/multitool.reason: Plain multitool. Prints at round start.

/obj/item/multitool/abductor.name: alien multitool
/obj/item/multitool/abductor.reason: Alien tool that works in a tenth of the normal time. A full set takes a reinforced wall apart in seconds, which helps boarding and repair but wins no fight by itself.

/obj/item/multitool/circuit.name: circuit multitool
/obj/item/multitool/circuit.reason: Multitool for circuit work. No faster than a plain one.

/obj/item/multitool/cyborg.name: electronic multitool
/obj/item/multitool/cyborg.reason: Tool at half the normal time. Slightly faster work and nothing else.

/obj/item/nanite_remote.name: nanite remote control
/obj/item/nanite_remote.note: Holds a 0-9999 signal code, a relay code and a mode (off, self, target within 7, everyone in view within 7, relay) set through a UI that can be locked to research access. The signal sending is in afterattack, which the attack code only reaches for items without NOBLUDGEON, and the remote has NOBLUDGEON, so by my reading of the code it never sends anything.
/obj/item/nanite_remote.reason: Sends a code to the nanites of one person or everyone in view, with no cooldown. Sets off any program waiting on that code, and a kill code wipes a program. Prints for 20 cr of material.

/obj/item/nanite_remote/comm.name: nanite communication remote
/obj/item/nanite_remote/comm.note: Same as the nanite remote but sends a typed text message along with the code, which only nanite comm-type programs act on. Its sending is also in afterattack, so by my reading it never fires while the item is NOBLUDGEON. / Holds a 0-9999 signal code, a relay code and a mode (off, self, target within 7, everyone in view within 7, relay) set through a UI that can be locked to research access. The signal sending is in afterattack, which the attack code only reaches for items without NOBLUDGEON, and the remote has NOBLUDGEON, so by my reading of the code it never sends anything.
/obj/item/nanite_remote/comm.reason: Sends text to matching nanite programs in one person or everyone in view, with no cooldown. Prints for little material.

/obj/item/nanite_scanner.name: nanite scanner
/obj/item/nanite_scanner.note: Hitting a living mob reads its nanites: saturation, safety threshold, cloud ID and sync state, and each program as active, inactive or crashed (the program list is replaced by a diagnostics-disabled notice if the host has turned that off). Stealth does not hide them; it reports no nanites if there are none.

/obj/item/ore_sensor.name: ore sensor
/obj/item/ore_sensor.reason: Crafted bone ore sensor. Small range and it needs brimdust to make.

/obj/item/pickaxe.name: pickaxe
/obj/item/pickaxe.reason: Plain pick. Prints at round start and hits for 15, but it's heavy to carry.

/obj/item/pickaxe/diamond.name: diamond-tipped pickaxe
/obj/item/pickaxe/diamond.reason: Digs in about a third of the normal time. 1,200 cr at the green waystation, a fair first upgrade.

/obj/item/pickaxe/divining.name: divining pick
/obj/item/pickaxe/divining.reason: Authored unique. Each rock you break can crack up to 24 more around it. Nothing else clears ground like it.

/obj/item/pickaxe/drill.name: mining drill
/obj/item/pickaxe/drill.reason: Digs at a little over half the normal time. Cheap and printable after 40 research points. The usual first upgrade.

/obj/item/pickaxe/drill/cyberware.name: rockjaw drill
/obj/item/pickaxe/drill/cyberware.reason: Implant drill. Half-time digging with your hands free. The implant is the real purchase.

/obj/item/pickaxe/drill/diamonddrill.name: diamond-tipped mining drill
/obj/item/pickaxe/drill/diamonddrill.reason: Digs in a fifth of the normal time. The same research node as the jackhammer, at a third of the material.

/obj/item/pickaxe/drill/jackhammer.name: sonic jackhammer
/obj/item/pickaxe/drill/jackhammer.reason: Fastest digger: a tenth of the normal time. It speeds up ore income but opens nothing new.

/obj/item/pickaxe/emergency.name: emergency disembarkation tool
/obj/item/pickaxe/emergency.reason: Plain-speed pick from emergency kits. Hits for 15, but it's heavy to carry.

/obj/item/pickaxe/improvised.name: improvised pickaxe
/obj/item/pickaxe/improvised.reason: Taped-together pick at a third of the normal speed. Better than bare hands.

/obj/item/pickaxe/mini.name: compact pickaxe
/obj/item/pickaxe/mini.reason: Plain-speed pick in a smaller size.

/obj/item/pickaxe/rusted.name: rusty pickaxe
/obj/item/pickaxe/rusted.reason: Plain-speed pick from a scrap crate.

/obj/item/pinpointer/crew.name: crew pinpointer
/obj/item/pinpointer/crew.reason: Tracks anyone with full suit sensors on, by name, enemy crews included. Prints for 25 cr of material. A real hunting tool against the careless.

/obj/item/pinpointer/material_sniffer.name: material sniffer
/obj/item/pinpointer/material_sniffer.reason: Crafted from an analyzer and some cable. Points at loose sheets of iron and glass. Minor.

/obj/item/pinpointer/nuke.name: pinpointer
/obj/item/pinpointer/nuke.reason: Points at a nuclear disk. No shop, ruin or played hull has it, and it only matters on the rare map that has a disk and a bomb.

/obj/item/pinpointer/old_hands_compass.name: old hand's compass
/obj/item/pinpointer/old_hands_compass.reason: Authored unique. Points at the nearest space ruin nobody has docked at, so it takes the search out of exploring.

/obj/item/pinpointer/vent.name: ventpointer
/obj/item/pinpointer/vent.reason: Points at nearby ore vents. 800 mining points for a shortcut you can walk.

/obj/item/pipe_dispenser.name: rapid pipe dispenser
/obj/item/pipe_dispenser.reason: Lays pipes and disposals fast. Ship upkeep, and common on hulls from the start.

/obj/item/rcd_ammo.name: RCD matter cartridge
/obj/item/rcd_ammo.reason: Matter cartridge. An RCD also reloads on iron and glass, so this gates nothing.

/obj/item/rcd_upgrade/anti_interrupt.name: RCD advanced upgrade: anti disruption
/obj/item/rcd_upgrade/anti_interrupt.reason: Adds a build option or quality-of-life trick to an RCD. It makes construction nicer, not a crew stronger.

/obj/item/rcd_upgrade/cooling.name: RCD advanced upgrade: enhanced cooling
/obj/item/rcd_upgrade/cooling.reason: Adds a build option or quality-of-life trick to an RCD. It makes construction nicer, not a crew stronger.

/obj/item/rcd_upgrade/frames.name: RCD advanced upgrade: frames
/obj/item/rcd_upgrade/frames.reason: Adds a build option or quality-of-life trick to an RCD. It makes construction nicer, not a crew stronger.

/obj/item/rcd_upgrade/furnishing.name: RCD advanced upgrade: furnishings
/obj/item/rcd_upgrade/furnishing.reason: Adds a build option or quality-of-life trick to an RCD. It makes construction nicer, not a crew stronger.

/obj/item/rcd_upgrade/silo_link.name: RCD advanced upgrade: silo link
/obj/item/rcd_upgrade/silo_link.reason: Adds a build option or quality-of-life trick to an RCD. It makes construction nicer, not a crew stronger.

/obj/item/rcd_upgrade/simple_circuits.name: RCD advanced upgrade: simple circuits
/obj/item/rcd_upgrade/simple_circuits.reason: Adds a build option or quality-of-life trick to an RCD. It makes construction nicer, not a crew stronger.

/obj/item/rcl.name: rapid pipe cleaner layer
/obj/item/rcl.reason: Lays pipe cleaners, which are art supplies.

/obj/item/reagent_containers/spray/chems.name: chem sprayer
/obj/item/reagent_containers/spray/chems.reason: Sprays a mix of six toxins, venom and pepper out to 7 tiles with no aim roll. Lethal to anyone not sealed up, and refillable. Only on one pirate hull.

/obj/item/reagent_containers/spray/cybor.name: lube spray
/obj/item/reagent_containers/spray/cybor.reason: 250 units of lube. Lays a slipping floor that stops a chase. One ruin.

/obj/item/reagent_containers/spray/hercu.name: medical spray (hercuri)
/obj/item/reagent_containers/spray/hercu.reason: Medical spray of hercuri for burns. A useful field heal found in many ship rooms and ruins.

/obj/item/reagent_containers/spray/medic.name: medical spray bottle
/obj/item/reagent_containers/spray/medic.reason: Empty medical spray. As good as what you put in it.

/obj/item/reagent_containers/spray/peppe.name: pepperspray
/obj/item/reagent_containers/spray/peppe.reason: Knocks down for 3 s and blinds for 6 from up to 4 tiles, unless eyes and mouth are covered. 10 sprays. Cheap, and any sealed helmet stops it.

/obj/item/reagent_containers/spray/peppe.name: pepperspray
/obj/item/reagent_containers/spray/peppe.reason: The same pepper spray sold empty, so it needs capsaicin before it does anything.

/obj/item/reagent_containers/spray/water.name: water flower
/obj/item/reagent_containers/spray/water.reason: Thirty units of lube in a flower. One ruin.

/obj/item/reagent_containers/spray/water.name: clown flower
/obj/item/reagent_containers/spray/water.reason: Thirty units of a lube that even no-slip shoes don't beat. One ruin.

/obj/item/resonator.name: resonator
/obj/item/resonator.note: Clicking a tile places a field that bursts after 2 seconds (auto) or when hit again (manual, toggled in hand), dealing 20 brute to everything on the tile, tripled at pressure 50 or below, and slowing them for 10 seconds. A burst also drills mineral on its tile, sets off fields on adjacent tiles, and spreads fields onto adjacent rock with a falling chance. Max 4 fields, and hitting a field to pop it early does 80% damage; the upgraded version holds 6, pops at full damage and adds a matrix mode that bursts when anything walks onto the tile. Fields hurt the user and allies too.
/obj/item/resonator.reason: Mining field that bursts on a 2 s fuse or a second click. 20 brute through armor, 60 in low pressure, with a slow. Good on rock, tricky on anyone who keeps moving.

/obj/item/resonator/upgraded.name: upgraded resonator
/obj/item/resonator/upgraded.note: Clicking a tile places a field that bursts after 2 seconds (auto) or when hit again (manual, toggled in hand), dealing 20 brute to everything on the tile, tripled at pressure 50 or below, and slowing them for 10 seconds. A burst also drills mineral on its tile, sets off fields on adjacent tiles, and spreads fields onto adjacent rock with a falling chance. Max 4 fields, and hitting a field to pop it early does 80% damage; the upgraded version holds 6, pops at full damage and adds a matrix mode that bursts when anything walks onto the tile. Fields hurt the user and allies too.
/obj/item/resonator/upgraded.reason: Mining tool that also hurts people. A field does 20 brute through any armor, 60 in low pressure, and slows for 10 s. It pops on a second click at full damage or lies as a trap. Prints for 28 cr of material.

/obj/item/restraints/handcuffs.name: handcuffs
/obj/item/restraints/handcuffs.reason: Holds anyone for up to a minute, and captures need them. 1 cr of material once researched, and on 22 job outfits.

/obj/item/restraints/handcuffs/alien.name: handcuffs
/obj/item/restraints/handcuffs/alien.reason: Handcuffs with alien looks. Holds anyone for up to a minute, and captures need them.

/obj/item/restraints/handcuffs/cable.name: cable restraints
/obj/item/restraints/handcuffs/cable.reason: Crafted from cable. Holds for 30 s.

/obj/item/restraints/handcuffs/cable/pin.name: cable restraints
/obj/item/restraints/handcuffs/cable/pin.reason: Cable cuffs in pink. Holds for 30 s.

/obj/item/restraints/handcuffs/cable/sin.name: sinew restraints
/obj/item/restraints/handcuffs/cable/sin.reason: Crafted from sinew. Holds for 30 s.

/obj/item/restraints/handcuffs/cable/zip.name: zipties
/obj/item/restraints/handcuffs/cable/zip.reason: Holds for 45 s. Cheap to print. One use.

/obj/item/restraints/legcuffs/beartrap.name: bear trap
/obj/item/restraints/legcuffs/beartrap.reason: Printable trap: 20 damage and 30 s to get out. Strong in a doorway, useless once seen.

/obj/item/restraints/legcuffs/beartrap/p.name: bear trap
/obj/item/restraints/legcuffs/beartrap/p.reason: Bear trap, already set. Found in ruins.

/obj/item/restraints/legcuffs/bola.name: bola
/obj/item/restraints/legcuffs/bola.note: Thrown at a carbon it lands and wraps their legs (breakout 3.5 seconds, leg-cuff movement slowdown of 7) unless they already wear leg restraints or lack two legs; it does not knock down. The energy bola instead turns into an uncatchable energy snare that works on prone or flying targets, with a 2 second breakout and slowdown 3; the retiarius net knocks down for 3 seconds with a 6 second breakout.
/obj/item/restraints/legcuffs/bola.reason: Crafted from iron and cable. Ties the legs for 3.5 s from one throw. No knockdown.

/obj/item/restraints/legcuffs/bola/cult.name: Nar'Sien bola
/obj/item/restraints/legcuffs/bola/cult.note: A bola that wraps legs with a 6 second breakout and a 3 second knockdown, and passes harmlessly through cultists. A non-cultist who picks it up is ensnared by it, or paralyzed for 6 seconds and made to drop it if already legcuffed or missing legs. / Thrown at a carbon it lands and wraps their legs (breakout 3.5 seconds, leg-cuff movement slowdown of 7) unless they already wear leg restraints or lack two legs; it does not knock down. The energy bola instead turns into an uncatchable energy snare that works on prone or flying targets, with a 2 second breakout and slowdown 3; the retiarius net knocks down for 3 seconds with a 6 second breakout.
/obj/item/restraints/legcuffs/bola/cult.reason: Traps any non-cultist who picks it up, so nobody can use it. One ruin.

/obj/item/restraints/legcuffs/bola/energ.name: energy bola
/obj/item/restraints/legcuffs/bola/energ.note: Thrown at a carbon it lands and wraps their legs (breakout 3.5 seconds, leg-cuff movement slowdown of 7) unless they already wear leg restraints or lack two legs; it does not knock down. The energy bola instead turns into an uncatchable energy snare that works on prone or flying targets, with a 2 second breakout and slowdown 3; the retiarius net knocks down for 3 seconds with a 6 second breakout.
/obj/item/restraints/legcuffs/bola/energ.reason: Printable snare that also works on prone or flying targets, and can't be caught. Short 2 s breakout.

/obj/item/restraints/legcuffs/bola/gonbo.name: gonbola
/obj/item/restraints/legcuffs/bola/gonbo.note: A bola with a 30 second breakout and no movement slowdown that also makes anyone it hits pacifist and mute until the bola is next dropped or removed. The pacify effect is applied on any carbon hit, even when the legs were not actually wrapped. / Thrown at a carbon it lands and wraps their legs (breakout 3.5 seconds, leg-cuff movement slowdown of 7) unless they already wear leg restraints or lack two legs; it does not knock down. The energy bola instead turns into an uncatchable energy snare that works on prone or flying targets, with a 2 second breakout and slowdown 3; the retiarius net knocks down for 3 seconds with a 6 second breakout.
/obj/item/restraints/legcuffs/bola/gonbo.reason: One thrown hit makes the target a mute pacifist until it comes off, with a 30 s breakout. It stops a gunfighter cold, but it needs a gondola hide, which is hard to find.

/obj/item/restraints/legcuffs/bola/retia.name: retiarius' weighted net
/obj/item/restraints/legcuffs/bola/retia.note: Thrown at a carbon it lands and wraps their legs (breakout 3.5 seconds, leg-cuff movement slowdown of 7) unless they already wear leg restraints or lack two legs; it does not knock down. The energy bola instead turns into an uncatchable energy snare that works on prone or flying targets, with a 2 second breakout and slowdown 3; the retiarius net knocks down for 3 seconds with a 6 second breakout.
/obj/item/restraints/legcuffs/bola/retia.reason: Weighted net: 3 s knockdown and a 6 s breakout from one throw. 1,800 cr at the Colosseum. A fair price for a real opener.

/obj/item/restraints/legcuffs/bola/tacti.name: reinforced bola
/obj/item/restraints/legcuffs/bola/tacti.note: Thrown at a carbon it lands and wraps their legs (breakout 3.5 seconds, leg-cuff movement slowdown of 7) unless they already wear leg restraints or lack two legs; it does not knock down. The energy bola instead turns into an uncatchable energy snare that works on prone or flying targets, with a 2 second breakout and slowdown 3; the retiarius net knocks down for 3 seconds with a 6 second breakout.
/obj/item/restraints/legcuffs/bola/tacti.reason: Reinforced bola: 3.5 s knockdown and a 7 s breakout from one throw. Found only on NPC ships.

/obj/item/rpd_upgrade.name: RPD advanced design disk
/obj/item/rpd_upgrade.reason: Blank pipe dispenser disk. It adds nothing.

/obj/item/rpd_upgrade/unwrench.name: RPD advanced upgrade: wrench mode
/obj/item/rpd_upgrade/unwrench.reason: Lets the pipe dispenser unwrench pipes. A small convenience.

/obj/item/rwd/loaded.name: rapid wiring device
/obj/item/rwd/loaded.reason: Lays wire fast. A work tool.

/obj/item/screwdriver.name: screwdriver
/obj/item/screwdriver.reason: Plain screwdriver. Prints at round start.

/obj/item/screwdriver/abductor.name: alien screwdriver
/obj/item/screwdriver/abductor.reason: Alien tool that works in a tenth of the normal time. A full set takes a reinforced wall apart in seconds, which helps boarding and repair but wins no fight by itself.

/obj/item/screwdriver/caravan.name: experimental screwdriver
/obj/item/screwdriver/caravan.reason: Experimental tool at about a third of the normal time. Faster work and nothing else.

/obj/item/screwdriver/cyborg.name: automated screwdriver
/obj/item/screwdriver/cyborg.reason: Tool at half the normal time. Slightly faster work and nothing else.

/obj/item/screwdriver/nuke.name: screwdriver
/obj/item/screwdriver/nuke.reason: Tool at half the normal time. Slightly faster work and nothing else.

/obj/item/screwdriver/power.name: hand drill
/obj/item/screwdriver/power.reason: Hand drill. A screwdriver and a wrench in one, a little faster. It saves a slot.

/obj/item/sensor_device.name: handheld crew monitor
/obj/item/sensor_device.reason: Handheld crew monitor showing your own crew's vitals and location. Medics want it.

/obj/item/shovel.name: shovel
/obj/item/shovel.reason: Plain shovel, 8 force. Prints at round start.

/obj/item/shovel/serrated.name: serrated bone shovel
/obj/item/shovel/serrated.note: With combat mode on, each hit on an organic mob (and each thrown hit) adds a second hit equal to its own force (10; 8 for the dull version) to the same limb, and does nothing extra to robots or other non-organic mobs. Digs at tool speed 0.3 (0.8 dull).
/obj/item/shovel/serrated.reason: Each hit on an organic target lands twice, for 20 a swing, the same as the green combat knife, and it digs fast. Needs a learned recipe or a ruin weapon roll.

/obj/item/shovel/serrated/dull.name: dull bone shovel
/obj/item/shovel/serrated/dull.note: With combat mode on, each hit on an organic mob (and each thrown hit) adds a second hit equal to its own force (10; 8 for the dull version) to the same limb, and does nothing extra to robots or other non-organic mobs. Digs at tool speed 0.3 (0.8 dull).
/obj/item/shovel/serrated/dull.reason: Dull bone shovel: each hit on an organic lands twice for 16. Slower dig. One ruin.

/obj/item/skeleton_key.name: skeleton key
/obj/item/skeleton_key.reason: Opens the old lavaland chests, but tendril chests here spawn unlocked, so it has nothing to open. Still 675 mining points on the console.

/obj/item/soap.name: soap
/obj/item/soap.reason: Plain bar, 60 cr. A bar on the floor also drops anyone who steps on it for 8 seconds. No-slip shoes beat it.

/obj/item/soap/deluxe.name: soap
/obj/item/soap/deluxe.reason: Cleans well. A bar on the floor also drops anyone who steps on it for 8 seconds. No-slip shoes beat it.

/obj/item/soap/homemade.name: soap
/obj/item/soap/homemade.reason: Homemade bar. A bar on the floor also drops anyone who steps on it for 8 seconds. No-slip shoes beat it.

/obj/item/soap/nanotrasen.name: soap
/obj/item/soap/nanotrasen.reason: Long-lasting bar. A bar on the floor also drops anyone who steps on it for 8 seconds. No-slip shoes beat it.

/obj/item/soap/omega.name: Omega soap
/obj/item/soap/omega.reason: Cleans almost instantly and lasts forever. A bar on the floor also drops anyone who steps on it for 8 seconds. No-slip shoes beat it.

/obj/item/soap/syndie.name: soap
/obj/item/soap/syndie.reason: Cleans fast. A bar on the floor also drops anyone who steps on it for 8 seconds. No-slip shoes beat it.

/obj/item/spess_knife.name: spess knife
/obj/item/spess_knife.reason: Pocket multi-tool: knife, screwdriver and cutters in the smallest size, and it sometimes picks the wrong tool. A convenience.

/obj/item/static_cuff.name: static cuff
/obj/item/static_cuff.reason: Authored unique, so it stays off shelves. For 4 minutes, cameras go to static around you and an AI can't track you. There's rarely anyone to hide from, so it's small.

/obj/item/style_meter.name: style meter attachment
/obj/item/style_meter.reason: Clips to glasses. A hot streak mines better and swaps items faster. Fun for miners, and small.

/obj/item/supplypod_beacon.name: Supply Pod Beacon
/obj/item/supplypod_beacon.reason: Tells an express cargo console where to drop pods. No shop, ruin or played hull has it.

/obj/item/survivalcapsule.name: bluespace shelter capsule
/obj/item/survivalcapsule.reason: Instant sealed shelter. 350 mining points. A way to survive a bad planet, not a way to win.

/obj/item/survivalcapsule/luxury.name: luxury bluespace shelter capsule
/obj/item/survivalcapsule/luxury.reason: Instant sealed room with better furnishing. 2,300 mining points. A portable safe spot.

/obj/item/survivalcapsule/luxuryelite.name: luxury elite bar capsule
/obj/item/survivalcapsule/luxuryelite.reason: Instant sealed bar with supplies, anywhere with room for it. 7,000 mining points for a safe room you can drop mid-trip.

/obj/item/t_scanner.name: T-ray scanner
/obj/item/t_scanner.reason: Shows wires and pipes under the floor. A work tool.

/obj/item/t_scanner/adv_mining_scanner.name: advanced automatic mining scanner
/obj/item/t_scanner/adv_mining_scanner.reason: Shows ore within 7 tiles on its own. 300 cr at the green waystation. Right price, right place.

/obj/item/t_scanner/adv_mining_scanner/l.name: automatic mining scanner
/obj/item/t_scanner/adv_mining_scanner/l.reason: Shows ore within 4 tiles on its own, more slowly. Common on hulls.

/obj/item/tank/internals/emergency_oxyge.name: emergency oxygen tank
/obj/item/tank/internals/emergency_oxyge.reason: Breathing gas. Every crew needs it and nobody should have to earn it. Small pocket tank.

/obj/item/tank/internals/emergency_oxyge.name: double emergency oxygen tank
/obj/item/tank/internals/emergency_oxyge.reason: Breathing gas. Every crew needs it and nobody should have to earn it. Twice the small tank.

/obj/item/tank/internals/emergency_oxyge.name: double emergency oxygen tank
/obj/item/tank/internals/emergency_oxyge.reason: Breathing gas. Every crew needs it and nobody should have to earn it. Twice the small tank, sold empty.

/obj/item/tank/internals/emergency_oxyge.name: emergency oxygen tank
/obj/item/tank/internals/emergency_oxyge.reason: Breathing gas. Every crew needs it and nobody should have to earn it. Small pocket tank, sold empty.

/obj/item/tank/internals/emergency_oxyge.name: extended-capacity emergency oxygen tank
/obj/item/tank/internals/emergency_oxyge.reason: Breathing gas. Every crew needs it and nobody should have to earn it. A larger pocket tank.

/obj/item/tank/internals/emergency_oxyge.name: funny emergency oxygen tank
/obj/item/tank/internals/emergency_oxyge.reason: A joke tank of odd gas in a clown's kit.

/obj/item/tank/internals/emergency_oxyge.name: extended-capacity emergency oxygen tank

/obj/item/tank/jetpack/carbondioxide.name: jetpack (carbon dioxide)
/obj/item/tank/jetpack/carbondioxide.note: Worn on the back and toggled on, it gives thrust in zero-g and space: each move input burns 0.01 mol from the tank onto the turf, it shuts off when the tank runs dry, and it keeps drifting unless stabilization is switched on. Most types also give a small speed boost while floating; an EMP switches it off for 4 seconds, and in a hyperspace corridor a working jetpack frees the wearer from hyperspace's pull. Oxygen types start at 6 atm and double as internals (the CO2 one cannot); the improvised one starts empty, holds 20 L, thrusts weaker, has no speed boost and has a 1 in 251 chance per thrust to cut out.
/obj/item/tank/jetpack/carbondioxide.reason: Lets you steer in space and adds a bit of speed. Takes the back slot, so no backpack. It can't double as internals.

/obj/item/tether_anchor.name: tether anchor
/obj/item/tether_anchor.reason: Crafted anchor for a safety line in zero gravity.

/obj/item/transporter_transponder.name: site-to-ship transponder
/obj/item/transporter_transponder.reason: Squeeze it and your ship's transporter pad pulls you home, with nobody at the console. An escape button, but useless without the pad, which costs bluespace.

/obj/item/universal_scanner.name: universal scanner
/obj/item/universal_scanner.reason: Reads export prices and prints price tags.

/obj/item/watertank.name: backpack water tank
/obj/item/watertank.reason: Backpack of water for plants. Slows you.

/obj/item/watertank/atmos.name: backpack firefighter tank
/obj/item/watertank/atmos.reason: Firefighter backpack with foam and breach-sealing resin. Good damage control. On 4 hulls.

/obj/item/watertank/janitor.name: backpack cleaner tank
/obj/item/watertank/janitor.reason: Backpack of space cleaner. Slows you.

/obj/item/watertank/pepperspray.name: ANTI-TIDER-2500 suppression backpack
/obj/item/watertank/pepperspray.reason: 1,000 units of pepper with a 6-tile nozzle. It knocks down and blinds a corridor of anyone without eye and mouth cover. Takes the back slot and slows you.

/obj/item/weldingtool/abductor.name: alien welding tool
/obj/item/weldingtool/abductor.reason: Alien tool that works in a tenth of the normal time. A full set takes a reinforced wall apart in seconds, which helps boarding and repair but wins no fight by itself. This one also refills its own fuel.

/obj/item/weldingtool/experimental.name: experimental welding tool
/obj/item/weldingtool/experimental.reason: Refills itself, works in half the time and is kinder to the eyes. The best welder a crew can print or buy.

/obj/item/weldingtool/hugetank.name: upgraded industrial welding tool
/obj/item/weldingtool/hugetank.reason: Holds 80 fuel. Fewer trips to the tank.

/obj/item/weldingtool/largetank.name: industrial welding tool
/obj/item/weldingtool/largetank.reason: Holds 40 fuel. Fewer trips to the tank.

/obj/item/weldingtool/largetank/cyborg.name: integrated welding tool
/obj/item/weldingtool/largetank/cyborg.reason: Double fuel at half the normal time. Slightly faster work.

/obj/item/weldingtool/largetank/empty.name: industrial welding tool
/obj/item/weldingtool/largetank/empty.reason: Holds 40 fuel, sold dry. Fewer trips to the tank.

/obj/item/weldingtool/slagmaw.name: Slagmaw
/obj/item/weldingtool/slagmaw.reason: Authored unique, so it stays off shelves. One 3-second pass fully repairs a window, structure or machine, and it turns scrap metal into fuel. A strong repair tool.

/obj/item/wirecutters.name: wirecutters
/obj/item/wirecutters.reason: Plain wirecutters. Prints at round start.

/obj/item/wirecutters/abductor.name: alien wirecutters
/obj/item/wirecutters/abductor.reason: Alien tool that works in a tenth of the normal time. A full set takes a reinforced wall apart in seconds, which helps boarding and repair but wins no fight by itself.

/obj/item/wirecutters/caravan.name: experimental wirecutters
/obj/item/wirecutters/caravan.reason: Experimental tool at about a third of the normal time. Faster work and nothing else.

/obj/item/wirecutters/cyborg.name: powered wirecutters
/obj/item/wirecutters/cyborg.reason: Tool at half the normal time. Slightly faster work and nothing else.

/obj/item/wrench.name: wrench
/obj/item/wrench.reason: Plain wrench. Prints at round start.

/obj/item/wrench/abductor.name: alien wrench
/obj/item/wrench/abductor.reason: Alien tool that works in a tenth of the normal time. A full set takes a reinforced wall apart in seconds, which helps boarding and repair but wins no fight by itself.

/obj/item/wrench/bolter.name: bolter wrench
/obj/item/wrench/bolter.reason: With the panel open, raises the bolts on an unreinforced airlock in 5 seconds, power or no power. Boarders want one, and door bolts stop being a full answer.

/obj/item/wrench/caravan.name: experimental wrench
/obj/item/wrench/caravan.reason: Experimental tool at about a third of the normal time. Faster work and nothing else.

/obj/item/wrench/combat.name: combat wrench
/obj/item/wrench/combat.reason: Works as a wrench only when switched on, and hits for 6. All style.

/obj/item/wrench/cyborg.name: hydraulic wrench
/obj/item/wrench/cyborg.reason: Tool at half the normal time. Slightly faster work and nothing else.

/obj/item/wrench/medical.name: medical wrench
/obj/item/wrench/medical.reason: Plain wrench with a joke attached.

method: No formula. Each tool is judged by what it lets a crew do that a plain tool doesn't, in plain groups, then against the disabler, laser gun and mesons. Authored uniques go above only if they'd warp a round on a shelf; harmless ones rate as what they do. Anomaly cores rate as what they make.
